name: A shared pool with absorptive-capacity limits
description: Four countries with different incomes each contribute a fixed rate of income to a shared pool. The pool is redistributed by a fixed share, but each country can only absorb up to its own capacity; whatever a country cannot absorb is tracked as an unused aggregate rather than silently disappearing or being redistributed again.
scope: Illustrative entity/aggregate allocation toy. Incomes, the contribution rate, the distribution shares and the capacity limits are all guesses picked to make every branch of the capacity logic exercise (one country under capacity, one exactly at it, two capped). Not a model of any real transfer scheme.
